title: Add JSON Schema Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight, zero‑dependency middleware that validates incoming request bodies against JSON Schema definitions. This prevents malformed data from reaching route handlers, improves security, and reduces boilerplate validation code across the application.
testCases: Validate that a request with a valid payload passes through to the handler and returns the expected response
Validate that a request with an invalid payload is rejected with a 400 status and a detailed error message
acceptance: When a route registers a schema, the middleware must (1) allow requests matching the schema to reach the handler unchanged, (2) block non‑matching requests with a 400 response containing the validation errors, and (3) not affect routes without a schema. All tests pass and existing test suite remains green.
reason: Ensures data integrity and security across the framework, reduces repetitive validation code for developers, and aligns with the recent stability focus while keeping the framework lightweight.
